items.title: Vikram Misri says India ready to help rebuild Nepal’s flood-hit infrastructure
items.blurb: New Delhi is prepared to consider Nepal’s proposals for assistance and reconstruction projects following the Bhotekoshi flood.

items.title: Floods push back Siddhababa tunnel opening to mid-January
items.blurb: The Bhotekoshi and Kaligandaki floods disrupted the delivery of electrical and safety equipment, delaying plans to open the tunnel to traffic.

items.title: Improving disaster communication
items.blurb: Early warning begins with understanding hazards and assessing risks, and continues through clear communication, interpretation of alerts, risk perceptions and decisive actions.
